comments.author: @rickysingh9544
comments.text:
Paji, as a Himachali, even I hadn’t explored Kangra the way you showed it in your video.
You genuinely do amazing work. First your Dharamshala vlog, and now this Kangra video — both were absolutely beautiful.

Watching your videos feels so special because you don’t just show places, you show the real beauty, culture, and warmth of Himachal. I’m from Yol myself, but honestly even I didn’t know so much about these areas until I watched your content.

The way you captured the people, their hospitality, and the peaceful vibe of Kangra was just heartwarming. The locals there are truly wonderful and welcome guests with so much love and respect.

Keep making such amazing videos, paji. You’re making Himachal look even more beautiful to the world
That soda shop scene really hit me emotionally ❤
We used to go there so much during childhood, and watching it again in your video brought back so many beautiful memories. For a moment, it genuinely felt like I was back in those old days.

You didn’t just make a travel video, paji — you made us relive our childhood memories. Truly emotional and beautiful work 🙏
